Color identity: BG | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 46 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite card draw; Near-infinite lifeloss; Near-infinite lifegain triggers; Destroy all creatures opponents control; Destroy each creature that enters the battlefield under an opponent's control; Lock; Near-infinite -1/-1 counters; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite draw triggers
Start: Yawgmoth, Thran Physician (battlefield); Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons (battlefield); Al Bhed Salvagers (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
  Your life total is at least 2.
  An opponent controls a creature.
Steps: Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
  When the sacrificed creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
  Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
  Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
  Repeat.
Notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

Color identity: BG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 8 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite creature tokens; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers
Start: Scouring Swarm (battlefield); Beifong's Bounty Hunters (battlefield); Yahenni, Undying Partisan (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control a land.
  You control another nonland creature.
Steps: Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
  When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
  Resolve the Yahenni ability.
  Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
  When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
  Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
  Resolve the Yahenni ability.
  Repeat.
Notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

  Repeat.

## Combo 5662-6797--5--195
Cards: Reyhan, Last of the Abzan + Phantom Train
Color identity: BG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 33 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers

Requires: Increases +1/+1 Counter Placement but not -1/-1 (battlefield)
Start: Reyhan, Last of the Abzan (battlefield); Phantom Train (battlefield)
Prerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Steps: Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.

  Resolve Reyhan's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
  If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
  Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
  Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
  Repeat.

  Repeat.
